items.titleZh: 安东内利蒙扎第19位发车夺冠，并列F1历史最低位夺冠第二
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在2026年意大利大奖赛从第19位发车夺冠，使其在F1历史上最低发车位置夺冠排名中并列第二。
items.originalTitle: F1最低发车夺冠排名：安东内利2026意大利站并列第二
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli's victory at the 2026 Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid puts him joint second in F1 history for wins from the lowest starting positions.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在2026年意大利大奖赛的胜利，使他与从最低发车位置赢得一级方程式大奖赛的排名并列第二。
安东内利不得不接受引擎罚退，这意味着他在蒙扎从第19位发车，面对家乡车迷。
但安东内利以出色的表现一路杀回前列，在比赛最后阶段超越梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔并夺冠。
这一成绩超越了马克斯·维斯塔潘在2024年巴西大奖赛从第17位发车夺冠的表现——也胜过数据统计上一级方程式史上最伟大的车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿和迈克尔·舒马赫的类似成就。
汉密尔顿在这方面的最佳表现是在2018年德国大奖赛混乱的混合天气条件下从第14位发车夺冠，而舒马赫的最佳表现则是在1995年比利时大奖赛同样多变的天气中为贝纳通从第16位夺冠。
第17位 - 约翰·沃森 - 1982年底特律大奖赛
迈凯伦车手约翰·沃森在1982年首届F1底特律街道赛中从车阵中一路突围夺冠，而且几乎没有多少其他车手退赛的帮助；虽然早期领跑并最终夺冠的凯克·罗斯伯格（Keke Rosberg）的威廉姆斯赛车确实在多个方面出了问题，包括其固特异轮胎在正赛日的表现不如沃森的米其林轮胎。
排位赛中和奇科·塞拉的菲蒂帕尔迪赛车发生碰撞，是沃森排位如此靠后的部分原因。
第17位起步——基米·莱科宁——2005年日本大奖赛
这是本榜单中唯一一个超车夺冠是在比赛最后一圈才完成的名次。
迈凯伦和基米·莱科宁在2005赛季的大部分时间里凭借纯粹的速度占据统治地位，但糟糕的可靠性意味着雷诺的费尔南多·阿隆索在铃鹿比赛之前就已经锁定车手总冠军。而在这场比赛中，F1最后几届“单圈排位赛”（每辆车单独计时的一次性排位赛）之一的雨水来得很不是时候，导致莱科宁第17位发车。
虽然他从那里迅速向前追赶，但要追上阿隆索的队友、杆位发车并领跑比赛的吉安卡洛·费斯切拉看起来仍然是一项艰巨的任务——当迈凯伦在最后一次加油进站后重新加入比赛时（这是不允许在赛中换胎的赛季），雷诺仍然领先莱科宁10.7秒，而此时距离比赛结束只剩8圈。
但在最后一圈刚刚开始时，莱科宁仍然在第一号弯的外侧追上并超越了费斯切拉。
第17位 - 马克斯·维斯塔潘 - 2024年巴西大奖赛
由于阿尔本在排位赛中撞车而未能起步，严格来说维斯塔潘在英特拉格斯这场雨战中是发车线上第16位起步的车，但因为阿尔本的发车位空着，卫冕冠军的红牛车队赛车在官方记录上是第17位发车。
然而他在第二圈就进入了前十名，到第11圈已经进入了前六名。
维斯塔潘确实获得了一些运气，因为早期领跑的拉塞尔和诺里斯在虚拟安全车期间进站换上了免费的中性胎，排名跌落到了他的身后。
这使得奥孔和维斯塔潘上升到了第一和第二位——随后弗兰科·科拉平托撞车引发红旗，他们得以在红旗期间“免费”更换轮胎。
在那之后，维斯塔潘只需要在之后的一次安全车重启时超越奥孔的阿尔派赛车，然后一路统治比赛直到终点。
第18名——鲁本斯·巴里切罗——2000年德国大奖赛
导致鲁本斯·巴里切罗的法拉利在霍根海姆发车区仅排第18位的电气故障，是他在车队效力期间运气不佳的典型写照——在2000年代上半期这支统治级车队里，他一直充当舒马赫的副手。
但这场比赛以广为人知的感人方式为他带来了首个一级方程式分站冠军，堪称职业生涯的巅峰。
当舒马赫在第一个弯角的事故中退赛时，巴里切罗充分利用两停策略顺利冲上第三名，但远落后于统治比赛的迈凯伦车手米卡·哈基宁和大卫·库特哈德。
随后，一名抗议自己被梅赛德斯解雇的人闯入赛道，安全车因此出动；期间库特哈德错过了迈凯伦要求进站的呼叫，名次大跌，巴里切罗得以升至第二位。
当雨水在比赛尾声来袭时，他不顾车队的建议，大胆地留在赛道上继续使用光头胎，并且成功跑出了效果，拿下了一场非同寻常的胜利，这一战也因此成为第一。
第19位发车——比尔·武科维奇——1954年印第安纳波利斯500大赛
这是一个特例——F1在其头一个十年里把印第安纳波利斯500算作积分世界锦标赛的一站，这本身就是一种怪现象，尽管参加F1赛季其余比赛的车手极少有人去跑这场比赛，印地车手也几乎从不出现在F1赛历的其他任何地方。
因此，尽管印地赛车传奇武科维奇从第19位发车并最终掌控了这场比赛，无疑是一场伟大的表现，但它在F1史上低排位发车取胜的官方榜单上被列为并列第二，这个身份多少有些尴尬。
第19名 - 安东内利 - 2026年意大利大奖赛
即使在一号减速弯出口处一度冲进砂石缓冲区，也没能阻止安东内利从发车位的第19位一路冲到第一名。
凭借一台全新的梅赛德斯引擎，安东内利迅速穿越车阵，在比赛完成不到三分之一赛程时就已处于领先位置。
队友拉塞尔确实重新超过了他，车队一度冻结了两人的位置，随后一次虚拟安全车中断出现，安东内利借此进行了第二次换胎。
随后他在轮胎更旧的情况下追赶拉塞尔，并在还剩三圈时完成超越拿下胜利——尽管此前他刚冲进第一个减速弯的砂石区。
安东内利此前最好的成绩是在蒙特利尔从发车位的第二位起步并夺冠。他的另外五场胜利全部是从杆位起步获得的。
第22位——约翰·沃森——1983年美国西部大奖赛
沃森在这份榜单上的第二次亮相应该会作为一项一级方程式纪录保持很长时间——因为目前只有22辆赛车的发车区最多只能追平它，而无法超越它。
他和迈凯伦队友尼基·劳达都属于使用米其林轮胎的车手中对该公司的排位赛轮胎在长滩街道赛道上表现不满的人，他们分别只排在发车位的第22和第23位，比杆位慢了4秒。
但他们的正赛节奏截然相反，这次还多亏了前方出现的一点混乱——早期领先对手凯克·罗斯伯格与帕特里克·坦贝发生碰撞，随后里卡多·帕特雷塞在试图超越新领跑者雅克·拉菲特时冲出赛道。到75圈中的第45圈时，他们已经攀升至第一和第二，并从此掌控了比赛。沃森虽然在起步时输给了队友，但在途中又重新反超了劳达。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli's 2026 Italian Grand Prix victory puts him joint second in the rankings for the lowest grid positions from which a Formula 1 grand prix has been won.
Antonelli had to take an engine grid penalty, which meant he started 19th at Monza in front of his home crowd.
But Antonelli roared back through the field in style, overtaking Mercedes team-mate George Russell in the dying stages of the race to win.
It eclipses Max Verstappen's 2024 Brazilian Grand Prix win from 17th on the grid - and similar achievements by F1’s statistically all-time greatest drivers Lewis Hamilton and Michael Schumacher.

Hamilton’s best on this front so far is his win from 14th in the chaotic mixed conditions of the 2018 German GP, while Schumacher’s is winning the 1995 Belgian GP from 16th for Benetton in similarly changeable weather.
17th - John Watson - 1982 Detroit Grand Prix

McLaren driver John Watson carved through the field to win F1’s inaugural Detroit street race in 1982 with relatively little help from attrition, though early leader and eventual champion Keke Rosberg’s Williams did wilt in multiple ways including its Goodyear tyres not faring as well on race day as Watson’s Michelins.
A qualifying collision with Chico Serra’s Fittipaldi was part of the reason Watson was so far down the grid.
17th - Kimi Raikkonen - 2005 Japanese Grand Prix
The only entry on this list where the charge to victory was completed on the very last lap of the race.

McLaren and Kimi Raikkonen had dominated much of the 2005 season on raw pace but poor reliability meant Renault’s Fernando Alonso was already champion before the Suzuka race, where ill-timed rain in one of F1’s final ‘one-shot’ single-car qualifying sessions left Raikkonen starting 17th.

Though he made rapid progress from there, catching Alonso’s polesitting and race-leading team-mate Giancarlo Fisichella looking like a tall order - with the Renault still 10.7s clear of Raikkonen when the McLaren rejoined after its final fuel stop (this was the season of no in-race tyre changes) with just eight laps to go.
But Raikkonen still hunted down and passed Fisichella around the outside of the first corner as the very last lap began.
17th - Max Verstappen - 2024 Brazilian Grand Prix

Alex Albon non-starting after his qualifying crash meant technically Verstappen was 16th in the line of cars starting the wet Interlagos race, but as Albon’s grid spot was left empty the reigning champion’s Red Bull was officially 17th on the grid.
Yet he was in the top 10 by lap two and the top six by lap 11.
Verstappen did get a stroke of luck when early leaders George Russell and Lando Norris made pitstops for free intermediate tyres during a virtual safety car period and dropped behind him.
That moved Esteban Ocon and Verstappen into first and second - and they were able to change their tyres ‘for free’ during a subsequent red flag for a Franco Colapinto crash.
All Verstappen had to do after that was dismiss Ocon’s Alpine at a later safety car restart and then dominate the race to the finish.
18th - Rubens Barrichello - 2000 German Grand Prix

The electrical problem that left Rubens Barrichello’s Ferrari only 18th on the Hockenheim grid was typical of his luck for much of his stint as Schumacher’s sidekick in the team that dominated the first half of the 2000s.
But the way the race came to him for a famously emotional first F1 win was a career high.

While Schumacher went out in a first-corner crash, Barrichello made good use of a two-stop strategy to charge smoothly into third but far behind the dominant McLarens of Mika Hakkinen and David Coulthard.

Then a track invader protesting against his dismissal from a job at Mercedes prompted a safety car during which Coulthard missed McLaren’s call to pit and tumbled down the order, promoting Barrichello to second.
That became first when he boldly stayed out on slick tyres - against the team’s advice - as rain hit the closing laps, and made it work to secure an extraordinary win.
19th - Bill Vukovich - 1954 Indianapolis 500

Here’s the anomalous one - a quirk of F1 counting the Indy 500 as a points-scoring world championship round in its first decade, even though it was rare in the extreme for anyone contesting the rest of the F1 season to enter it or for Indy drivers to appear anywhere else on the F1 schedule.

So though IndyCar legend Vukovich’s drive from 19th to eventually control this race was undoubtedly a great one, its status as officially joint second-best on F1’s all-time list of wins from low grid positions is somewhat awkward.
19th - Kimi Antonelli - 2026 Italian Grand Prix
Even a late trip into the gravel trap on the exit of the first chicane couldn't stop Antonelli from charging from 19th on the grid to first.
With a fresh Mercedes engine, Antonelli quickly cut through the field, leading the race after less than a third of the distance was completed.
Team-mate Russell did re-pass him, and the team temporarily froze their positions before a virtual safety car interruption, which Antonelli used to make a second change of tyres.
He then chased down Russell on older tyres, and overhauled him for victory with three laps to go - despite having gone into the first chicane gravel just before.
Antonelli's previous best was winning from second on the grid in Montreal. His other five victories were all from pole position.
22nd - John Watson - 1983 USA West Grand Prix
Watson’s second appearance on this list should hold as an F1 record for a long time further - with the current 22-car grid only able to equal it rather than eclipse it.

He and McLaren team-mate Niki Lauda were among many Michelin runners unimpressed with the firm’s qualifying tyres around the Long Beach street track as they lined up way down in 22nd and 23rd on the grid, 4s from pole.

But their race pace was the complete opposite, and this time helped by a little chaos up front that included a clash between early lead rivals Keke Rosberg and Patrick Tambay then Riccardo Patrese going off while trying to pass new leader Jacques Laffite. They made it through to first and second by lap 45 of 75 and controlled the race from there, Watson having got back ahead of Lauda along the way after losing out to his team-mate at the start.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛五大要点：安东内利击败拉塞尔
items.summaryZh: 在2026年F1意大利大奖赛上，基米·安东内利虽从发车末位起步，仍在主场蒙扎夺冠，这可能是他在冠军争夺中对乔治·拉塞尔的最重大打击。安东内利的表现不仅超越队友，甚至可能超越所有其他车手。

items.originalTitle: F1意大利大奖赛五大要点：安东内利击败拉塞尔
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won his home Italian GP at Monza in 2026 despite starting from the back of the grid, in what was probably the biggest blow he has dealt George Russell in the championship battle. His performance was at a different level compared not only to his team-mate but arguably everyone else.
detailZh: F1意大利大奖赛的五个快速要点
基米·安东内利尽管从发车末位起步，仍在自己的主场大奖赛中夺得冠军
这可能是基米·安东内利在积分榜争夺中对乔治·拉塞尔造成的最大打击。如果之前还不清楚的话，现在很明显：安东内利的表现处于另一个级别——不仅比他的队友强，可以说比其他所有车手都强。
蒙扎本应是拉塞尔追赶积分的大好机会，因为安东内利更换了新的动力单元组件，从发车末位起步。
相反，安东内利仅用了15圈多一点就爬升到拉塞尔之后的第二位，并加入了争夺冠军的战斗。他的进站打断了这场较量，但安东内利还是反超回来并取得了领先。他的第一次超车尝试略显笨拙，但在周日根本没有人能阻挡他。
迈凯伦未能实现三连胜。这支总部位于沃金的车队在连续两场胜利之后来到意大利大奖赛——兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利和荷兰夺冠——但车队一直清楚蒙扎对MCL40将是一场关键考验。
科拉平托，阿尔派车队；皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦车队
亨格罗林和赞德沃特拥有大量中速弯角，与“速度圣殿”蒙扎是完全不同的挑战。在蒙扎，长直道和减速弯对赛车提出了截然不同的要求。正因如此，Andrea Stella曾警告说，在意大利复制迈凯伦近期的状态，至少来说是极其困难的。
对迈凯伦来说不幸的是，这一警告被证明是有道理的，因为MCL40没能通过蒙扎的考验。如果车队像斯特拉所说的那样“发挥出应有的水平”，排位赛是否会产生不同的结果，这还有待观察。但在正赛中，无论是奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里还是诺里斯，都无法在周日发起有力的挑战。
法拉利的复盘开始变得有意思了
随着锦标赛的展开，刘易斯·汉密尔顿仍在争夺世界冠军，法拉利表面的友好氛围似乎开始出现一些裂痕。虽然汉密尔顿没有公开要求车队优先照顾自己，但当他质疑车队为何没有最大化争夺车手总冠军的机会——也就是支持这位七届世界冠军时，他的态度并不算含蓄。
不知是否巧合，在周日正赛起步阶段，夏尔·勒克莱尔似乎对队友格外用力地竞争，当汉密尔顿威胁要超越他时，他几乎没有在2号弯外侧留出空间。蒙扎的第一个减速弯特别紧凑，但正如背景中基米·安东内利所展示的，通过更贴近内侧的线路过2号弯是可以保持动量而不一路漂向出弯口的。
勒克莱尔（Leclerc）这次超车动作本身并没有什么大问题，如果被超的是红牛、梅赛德斯或迈凯伦的车，或许还会赢得掌声。但被超的偏偏是另一辆猩红色的法拉利。
车队肩负着巨大压力，要在要求苛刻的车迷面前展现竞争力，而汉密尔顿（Hamilton）暂时跌至第九位本可能严重毁掉他的比赛。结果，勒克莱尔在第2圈末尾的撞车亲手葬送了自己的比赛。
在下周的马德里大奖赛到来之前，如果领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔（Fred Vasseur）想让他的两张王牌保持在正轨上，看来得好好训话一番了。
又一次代价惨重的失误暴露了勒克莱尔的致命弱点
任何一个对F1只有基本了解的人都不会质疑勒克莱尔的速度。不过，他的致命弱点正变得越来越明显：他时不时会撞车。
周日的事情在蒙扎再次上演。在法拉利车迷面前，勒克莱尔失控，白白葬送了一次真正争夺领奖台的机会。
他之前也犯过引人注目的错误，包括2020年在蒙扎以及在摩纳哥。然而他在2024年在这两条赛道上都赢过——这证明只要他做对了，他能有多出色。
勒克莱尔今后还会有许多亮眼的表现，但代价高昂的失误依然存在——而本赛季他与汉密尔顿的差距已经比法拉利所希望的更大了。
阿尔派 的夺冠企图美好得不像是真的
皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利）惊艳的杆位既出人意料又令人印象深刻——尤其是因为它完全凭实力取得。没错，他得益于尾流，但并没有多变的天气或中断来打乱排位秩序。加斯利在整个排位赛中都很快，并在关键时刻做出了惊人的一圈。
然而，在蒙扎面对 F1 的大车队，这大概已经是 阿尔派 所能指望的最好结果了。到了周日，情况很快明朗：加斯利不会去争夺胜利。
梅赛德斯、法拉利、红牛和迈凯伦的车手们一个接一个地超越了他，最终加斯利名列第七——如果不是从杆位发车，这本是一个他通常会感到高兴的成绩。尽管如此，对于恩斯通车队来说，这仍是一个强劲的结果，并且在争夺车队总冠军第五名的战斗中极为重要。
detailEn: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Italian GP
Kimi Antonelli took victory at his home race despite starting from the back of the grid

This was probably the biggest blow Kimi Antonelli has dealt George Russell in the championship battle so far. If it wasn't already clear, Antonelli is performing at a different level - not only compared to his team-mate, but arguably everyone else too.
Monza was supposed to be Russell's big opportunity to claw back points, with Antonelli taking new power unit components and starting from the back of the grid.

Instead, it took Antonelli barely more than 15 laps to climb to second behind Russell and join the fight for victory. His pitstop interrupted that battle, but Antonelli came back and took the lead anyway. His first overtaking attempt was a little clumsy, but there was simply no stopping him on Sunday.

McLaren couldn’t make it three in a row. The Woking-based team arrived at the Italian Grand Prix on the back of two consecutive victories, with Lando Norris triumphing in Hungary and the Netherlands, but the team always knew Monza would be a crucial test for the MCL40.
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Oscar Piastri, McLaren

The Hungaroring and Zandvoort, with their abundance of medium-speed corners, are very different challenges to the Temple of Speed, where long straights and chicanes place very different demands on a car. That is why Andrea Stella had warned that replicating McLaren’s recent form in Italy would be, at the very least, a tall order.

Unfortunately for McLaren, that warning proved justified, as the MCL40 failed its Monza test. It remains to be seen whether qualifying could have produced a different outcome had the team “executed at the level we should have,” as Stella put it. But in the race, neither Oscar Piastri nor Norris was able to mount a serious challenge on Sunday.
Ferrari debriefs are starting to get interesting

As the championship unfolds, and Lewis Hamilton remains in contention for the world title, the friendly facade at Ferrari appears to be showing a few cracks. While not overtly demanding priority, Hamilton wasn't all that subtle when he questioned why the Scuderia isn't maximising its chances to compete for the drivers' title, ergo backing the seven-time world champion.

Coincidence or not, Charles Leclerc appeared to be racing his team-mate extra hard at the start of Sunday's race, taking little effort to leave space on the outside of Turn 2 as Hamilton threatened to pass him. Monza's first chicane is particularly tight, but as Kimi Antonelli showed in the background, it is possible to keep the momentum with a tighter line through Turn 2 without drifting all the way towards the exit.

There wasn't a whole lot wrong with Leclerc's move in itself, and perhaps it would have been applauded if a Red Bull, Mercedes or McLaren had been on the receiving end. But not another scarlet Ferrari.

The Scuderia is under huge pressure to put up a competitive display in front of its demanding tifosi, and Hamilton temporarily dropping to ninth could have significantly scuppered his race. As it happened, Leclerc caused his own downfall with a crash at the end of Lap 2.
Heading into next week's race in Madrid, it appears as though team principal Fred Vasseur will have some lecturing to do if he wants to keep his two aces on the straight and narrow.
Another costly mistake exposes Leclerc's Achilles' heel
Nobody with even a basic understanding of Formula 1 can question Leclerc's speed. His Achilles' heel, though, is becoming increasingly clear: every now and then, he crashes.
It happened again at Monza on Sunday. In front of the Ferrari tifosi, Leclerc lost control and threw away a genuine chance of fighting for the podium.
He has made high-profile mistakes before, including at Monza in 2020 and at Monaco. Yet he also won at both circuits in 2024 - proof of just how good he can be when he gets it right.
There will be plenty more standout performances from Leclerc, but the costly mistakes remain - at a time when the gap to Lewis Hamilton this season is already bigger than Ferrari would have wanted.
Alpine's victory bid was too good to be true

Pierre Gasly's sensational pole was as unexpected as it was impressive - especially as it came entirely on merit. Yes, he benefited from a slipstream, but there was no changeable weather or interruption to shake up the order. Gasly was quick throughout qualifying and delivered a stunning lap when it mattered.
Yet that was probably as good as Alpine could hope for at Monza against F1's big teams. On Sunday, it quickly became clear Gasly wasn't going to challenge for victory.

The Mercedes, Ferrari, Red Bull and McLaren drivers passed him one by one, leaving Gasly seventh - a result he would normally have been delighted with, had he not started from pole. Still, it was a strong result for the Enstone team and hugely important in the battle for fifth in the constructors' championship.

items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔谈与汉密尔顿碰撞：“谁在推动这种叙事？”
items.summaryEn: After clashing with team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the start of the Italian Grand Prix, Charles Leclerc said he doesn't understand "who is forcing that narrative" of a Ferrari rivalry, suggesting the media are pitting the Ferrari drivers against one another.
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔谈与刘易斯·汉密尔顿的冲突：“是谁在强行制造这种说法？”
勒克莱尔暗示是媒体在挑拨法拉利两位车手之间的关系
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
夏尔·勒克莱尔表示，他不明白“是谁在强行制造这种说法”，此前他在意大利大奖赛发车时与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生了冲突。
法拉利车手们在跃马的主场大奖赛中从第二排发车；两人起步都不错，但汉密尔顿在进入瓦里安特·德尔·雷蒂菲洛——赛道的前两个弯角时——与勒克莱尔并排。
这位七届世界冠军选择走内线，但勒克莱尔守住了位置，并在2号弯拿到内线路线。汉密尔顿仍然并排，但勒克莱尔没有给队友留出空间。比赛准则允许他这样做，因为从外侧超车的赛车必须在弯心处处于领先，才有资格获得比赛空间。
尽管如此，汉密尔顿还是很愤怒，因为他在这次事故中两个车轮压上了碎石路，损失了多个位置。
然而，当被问及这次碰撞时——在法拉利队友间合作近来一直受到讨论的大背景下——勒克莱尔进行了反驳。
“我真的不知道是谁在强行营造我们彼此对立的这种叙事，”他反驳道。
“我是说，说实话，在赞德沃特的时候，相关的谈论已经太多了。”在荷兰大奖赛上，两位车手都出现了策略混乱；勒克莱尔违背了法拉利的要求，延迟了进站，尽管汉密尔顿就在他身后紧追，因为他认为该策略对自己的比赛不利。
不过，这位摩纳哥车手承认，蒙扎事件在车迷面前显得很糟糕——尤其是因为他在下一圈就撞车退赛了。
“在这里，我们的确做得过火了，”他说。“我认为刘易斯在一号弯，然后二号弯，我尝试尽可能贴近弯心，但这还不够——在这里这样做是不好的。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc on Lewis Hamilton clash: “Who is forcing that narrative?”
Leclerc suggests the media are pitting the Ferrari drivers against one another
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Charles Leclerc says he doesn’t understand “who is forcing that narrative” of a Ferrari rivalry, after clashing with Formula 1 team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the start of the Italian Grand Prix.

The Ferrari drivers were starting from the second row for the Prancing Horse’s home race; both of them took a decent getaway, but Hamilton pulled alongside Leclerc coming into Variante del Rettifilo – the first two corners of the track.

The seven-time world champion went for the inside, but Leclerc held on and got the inside line for Turn 2. Hamilton was still alongside, but Leclerc didn’t leave room for his team-mate. Racing guidelines allowed him to act this way, as cars overtaking on the outside need to be ahead at the apex in order to be entitled to racing room.
Still, Hamilton was furious as he ended up with two wheels on the gravel and lost many positions in the incident.
However, when asked about the clash – within the wider context of Ferrari team-mate cooperation having been debated of late – Leclerc pushed back.
“I don't really know who is forcing that narrative that we are one against the other,” he retorted.

“I mean, honestly, Zandvoort, there was way too many talks already.” Back in the Dutch Grand Prix, there had been strategy confusion for both drivers; Leclerc had gone against Ferrari demands and delayed his pitstop, despite Hamilton being right behind him, as he deemed the strategy counterproductive for his own race.
Still, the Monegasque admitted that the Monza incident was a poor look in front of the tifosi – especially as he ended up crashing out on the following lap.

“Here, it's true though that we went too far,” he said. “I think Lewis in Turn 1, then Turn 2, I tried to do the tightest corner possible, but that was just not enough – and doing it here is not good.”
keyPointsZh: 两位法拉利车手从第二排发车，起步顺利，但汉密尔顿进入一号弯时与勒克莱尔并排，导致接触。
keyPointsEn: Both Ferrari drivers started from the second row and made good starts, but Hamilton ran alongside Leclerc into Turn 1, resulting in contact.

detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格：法拉利在刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔之间支持汉密尔顿“说不通”

刘易斯·汉密尔顿、夏尔·勒克莱尔、法拉利
2016年一级方程式冠军尼科·罗斯伯格表示，法拉利在2026年冠军争夺战中优先支持刘易斯·汉密尔顿而非夏尔·勒克莱尔是“不可行的”。
法拉利带着一场混乱的荷兰大奖赛的余波进入意大利大奖赛周末，在那场比赛中，尽管摩纳哥车手勒克莱尔采取了不同的策略，车队似乎仍不愿执行车队指令让汉密尔顿完成超越。
排位赛结束后，罗斯伯格在接受天空体育 F1采访时，回应了有关法拉利应该在2026年冠军争夺战中支持这位七届冠军得主的建议。
“他们不能这么做，”曾在2013年至2016年与汉密尔顿在梅赛德斯搭档的罗斯伯格在蒙扎的天空体育 F1转播中说。
“他们有两名一号车手，两人水平相当。你不能在赛季中期就把一切资源都只用来支持刘易斯。现在还为时过早，这样做没有意义。
"当然，对于Lewis来说，这会提升他赢得总冠军的机会，因为在最近五场比赛中，法拉利的车手几乎每一场比赛都缠斗在一起。当然，这会损耗他们的性能，最终也会让Lewis损失总冠军积分，但在这个阶段车队不可能这样对待Leclerc。那是行不通的。"
在意大利大奖赛之前，Hamilton在车手积分榜上落后领跑者安东内利 59分，而Leclerc则落后87分。
"今天的这场比赛对总冠军争夺至关重要，"Rosberg补充道。"这是George、Lewis，实际上也包括Lando，大幅追回积分的机会。但Lando今天基本上已经没戏了，他这个周末的速度不够快。"
detailEn: Nico Rosberg: Ferrari backing Lewis Hamilton over Charles Leclerc "doesn't make sense"
Nico Rosberg says Ferrari cannot realistically prioritise Lewis Hamilton over Charles Leclerc in the 2026 title race at this stage of the season
Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg says it is "not feasible" for Ferrari to prioritise Lewis Hamilton over Charles Leclerc in the 2026 title race.

Ferrari entered the Italian Grand Prix weekend on the back of a chaotic Dutch Grand Prix, during which the team seemed reluctant to enforce team orders to allow Hamilton to pass Leclerc, despite the Monegasque driver being on a different strategy.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1 following qualifying, Rosberg addressed suggestions that Ferrari should back the seven-time champion in the 2026 title fight.
"They can't do that," Rosberg, who was partnered with Hamilton at Mercedes from 2013 to 2016, said during the Sky Sports F1 broadcast at Monza.
"They have two No. 1 drivers, both on a similar level. You cannot, now in the middle of the season, put everything just working towards Lewis. It's way too early, and that doesn't make sense.

"Of course, for Lewis that would enhance his chances to win the championship because in the last five races the Ferrari drivers were all over each other almost every race. Of course, it costs them performance, and Lewis championship points eventually, but the team cannot do that at this stage against Leclerc. It's not feasible."
Prior to the Italian Grand Prix, Hamilton was 59 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli in the drivers' standings, whereas Leclerc was 87 points behind.

"It is a big race for the championship today," Rosberg added. "It's the chance for George, Lewis, actually also Lando, to make up some big points. But Lando is kind of out of it today, he has not been fast enough this weekend.
keyPointsZh: 法拉利在荷兰大奖赛上因不愿执行车队指令让汉密尔顿超越采用不同策略的勒克莱尔而陷入混乱。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari was thrown into confusion at the Dutch Grand Prix after declining to issue team orders for Hamilton to pass Leclerc, who was on a different strategy.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔承认与汉密尔顿意大利站首圈缠斗“过火”
items.summaryZh: F1意大利大奖赛开场圈，法拉利队友夏尔·勒克莱尔与刘易斯·汉密尔顿激烈缠斗，勒克莱尔赛后承认这次争夺“过火了”。
items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔承认与汉密尔顿首圈缠斗“过火”
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team-mates Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton fought hard in the opening corners of the Italian Grand Prix, with Leclerc admitting afterwards that the scrap "went too far".
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔承认，在F1意大利大奖赛的开局弯角中，他与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿的缠斗“太过火了”。
从发车区第四位起步的七届世界冠军汉密尔顿，在第一个减速弯冲入内侧，试图超越第三位起步的勒克莱尔。
两人在过弯时并排行驶，但汉密尔顿最终在出弯时被挤进了砂石区——他随后不久告诉比赛工程师“夏尔把我挤出去了”。
当被问及这一事件，以及关于法拉利车手需要协同作战的说法时，在第二圈末尾撞车退赛的勒克莱尔表示：“我真的不知道是谁在强行营造我们彼此对立的说法。”
“在赞德沃特的时候，谈话实在太多了。”
“不过在这里，说实话，我认为我们在第一弯对Lewis的做法确实过火了。然后在第二弯，我试图尽可能紧贴弯心走线，但这还不够，在这里这样做并不好。”
在赞德沃特，Hamilton因法拉利在他使用更新轮胎时没有让车而沮丧地在车队电台发表了强硬的言论，随后一周他就此事进行了道歉。
在蒙扎排位赛后，Hamilton表达了对法拉利执行层面的不满，并表示“我们必须作为一个团队来工作”，以扭转其争夺冠军的希望日益“黯淡”的趋势。
勒克莱尔在帕拉波利卡（阿尔博雷托）弯撞车后前往医疗中心接受检查，但很快便获准离开。
"脖子没事，只是起初视线有点问题，右眼看东西不太清楚，但现在一切都好了，这是我最担心的问题，"勒克莱尔在随后不久接受媒体采访时说道。
"然后在那之后，这里那里有一点疼痛，这在这样的撞车事故后是正常的，仅此而已。"
当被问及在下周于新马德里赛道马德里赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛之前，他将如何从这次失望中振作起来时，勒克莱尔回答说："嗯，首先，我认为今晚和明天我可能还要进行相当多的额外检查，以确保我在马德里能完全恢复良好。"
“按理说应该是这样，但稳妥起见总比后悔好。”
勒克莱尔认为迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的尝试超车并没有导致他的撞车，他说：“我不认为这是问题所在。我觉得从第一圈到第二圈，我的动力输出有一些差异。
“我们会调查一下，但在查看数据并百分之百确认之前，我不想评论太多。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc admits his scrap with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton "went too far" during the opening corners of Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix.
From fourth on the grid, seven-time world champion Hamilton went down the inside of third-place starter Leclerc into the first chicane.
They ran side-by-side through the corner, but Hamilton ended up being fed into the gravel on the exit - telling his race engineer shortly afterwards that "Charles pushed me off".

Asked about the incident in the context of talk that the Ferrari drivers need to work together, Leclerc - who crashed out at the end of the second lap - said: "I don't really know who is forcing that narrative that we are one against the other.
"At Zandvoort there were way too many talks already.

"Here it's true, though, that we went too far, I think, [with] Lewis in Turn 1. Then in Turn 2 I tried to do the tightest corner possible, but that was just not enough, and doing it here is not good."

At Zandvoort, Hamilton made some strong team radio comments in frustration at Ferrari not swapping its cars when Hamilton was on fresher tyres, something Hamilton issued an apology for in the week after.
After qualifying at Monza, Hamilton aired his frustration at Ferrari's execution and said "we do have to work as a team" to reverse the trend of its title chances becoming "dimmer".
Leclerc visited the medical centre after his crash at the Parabolica (Alboreto), but was quickly released.

"The neck was OK, it was just the vision a little bit at first, the right eye was not showing me great vision, but now it's all good, so that's the thing I was most worried of getting out of the car," Leclerc said when he spoke to media shortly afterwards.
"Then after that, a bit of pain here and there, which is normal after a crash like this, so nothing more."

Asked how he would pick himself up from that disappointment before next weekend’s Spanish GP at the new Madring circuit, Leclerc replied: "Well, first of all, I think I'll have quite a few additional checks that we still have to do on my side probably tonight and tomorrow to make sure that I'll be fully fine for Madrid.
"It should be the case, but better be safe than sorry."

Leclerc did not think McLaren driver Oscar Piastri trying for a move contributed to his crash, saying: "I wouldn't say that this is the issue. I think from lap one to lap two I had a bit of a difference in power delivery.
"We'll look into it, but I don't want to comment too much before checking the data and confirming it 100%."
keyPointsZh: 七届世界冠军汉密尔顿从第四位发车，在一号减速弯内侧攻击第三位的勒克莱尔。
两车并排过弯后，汉密尔顿在出弯时被挤进砂石区，随后告诉比赛工程师“夏尔把我挤出去了”。
勒克莱尔在第二圈末尾撞车退赛，被问及此事时表示：“我不知道是谁在强行营造我们彼此对立的说法。”
keyPointsEn: Seven-time world champion Hamilton started fourth and attacked third-placed Leclerc down the inside into the first chicane.
After running side-by-side, Hamilton ended up in the gravel at the exit, telling his race engineer "Charles pushed me off".
Leclerc, who crashed out at the end of lap two, said: "I don't really know who is forcing that narrative that we are one against the other."

勒克莱尔还不能百分之百确定自己能参加下周的西班牙大奖赛
夏尔·勒克莱尔表示，在意大利大奖赛撞车之后，他需要“进行几项额外的检查”，以确保自己能够以良好的身体状态参加下周在马德里举行的一级方程式比赛。
勒克莱尔在第二圈末尾高速通过帕拉波利卡弯时失去了对法拉利SF-26赛车的控制，并重重撞上了护墙，这次事故导致比赛出示了红旗。
这位摩纳哥车手被送往医疗中心，经检查未发现任何伤情，随后获准离开。
“脖子没事，只是一开始视力有点问题，”勒克莱尔说。“右眼看东西不太清楚，但现在都没问题了，这是我从车上下来的时最担心的事情。”
“除此之外，还有些这里那里的疼痛，发生这样的事故之后这很正常，没有更严重的问题。”
不过，这并不意味着这位28岁车手从事故中脱险后完全没有受伤。
“我想我的身体这边还有相当多额外的检查要做，可能就在今晚和明天进行，以确保我能完全健康地参加马德里站的比赛，”他补充道。“情况应该是这样的，但宁可谨慎小心，也不要事后后悔。”
至于他最初为何失控，勒克莱尔表示是“动力输出上的差异”，但他坚称希望先查看数据，而不是发表没有依据的评论。他也承认自己感到失望。
“是的，这非常令人沮丧，但现在的结果就是这样，我无法改变。我只能向前看，希望能在马德里反弹，”这位法拉利车手最后说道。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc needs further health checks after Monza F1 crash
Leclerc isn’t 100% certain he will race in next weekend’s Spanish Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he needs “a few additional checks” following his Italian Grand Prix crash, in order to make sure he’ll be fit next weekend for Formula 1’s Madrid round.
Leclerc lost control of his Ferrari SF-26 at high speed in the Parabolica at the end of lap two and suffered a hefty impact against the wall, which caused a red flag.
The Monegasque was taken to the medical centre, which he was released from in the absence of any detected injuries.

“The neck was OK, it was just the vision a little bit at first,” said Leclerc. “The right eye was not showing me great vision, but now it's all good, so that's the thing I was most worried of getting off the car.
“Then after that everything, a bit of pain here and there, which is normal after a crash like this, so nothing more.”
However, this doesn’t mean the 28-year-old emerged from the accident fully unscathed.

“I think I'll have quite a few additional checks that we still have to do on my side, probably tonight and tomorrow, to make sure that I'll be fully fine for Madrid,” he added. “It should be the case, but better be safe than sorry.”

As to why he lost control in the first place, Leclerc suggested "a difference in power delivery", but insisted he wanted to look at the data rather than make uninformed comments. He also admitted to his disappointment.
“Yeah, it's very frustrating, but it's the way it is now, I cannot change the results. I'll have to look forward and hopefully bounce back in Madrid,” the Ferrari racer concluded.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔严重撞车引发意大利大奖赛提前红旗
items.summaryZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛第二圈末段于最后一个弯出弯时发生严重撞车，比赛随即被红旗中断。
items.originalTitle: 勒克莱尔重大事故引发意大利大奖赛提前红旗
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc suffered a huge crash at the exit of the final corner at the end of lap two of the Italian Grand Prix, prompting an early red flag.
detailZh: 在第二圈结束时，夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）在最后一个弯道出弯处发生严重撞车后，F1意大利大奖赛被红旗中止。
首圈法拉利两车并排驶入一号弯，汉密尔顿从内侧切入勒克莱尔——在汉密尔顿看来，勒克莱尔随后将他挤出了赛道，使其在二号弯陷入砂石区。
勒克莱尔继续保持在第三位，然后在第二圈开始时短暂超越了杆位起步的皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利），但随即被反超，后来又跌至第四位，落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）的红牛赛车。
随后勒克莱尔的比赛宣告结束：他在通过Ascari减速弯时出现晃动，在Parabolica（Alboreto）弯失去了对法拉利赛车的控制，高速撞上了护栏。
皮亚斯特里 的迈凯伦当时正寻找机会切入弯角，而 Leclerc 似乎稍稍跑宽，压到了赛道旁的绿色柏油路面，他的法拉利随即发生了甩尾打转。
Leclerc 很快从他撞毁的法拉利中爬了出来，安全车随即出动，随后红旗也迅速亮出。
这次事故与 Leclerc 在 2020 年意大利大奖赛上于 Parabolica 弯撞车的情形非常相似。
法拉利在比赛即将重启前——当地时间下午 3 点 39 分——表示，Leclerc 已经离开了医疗中心。
红旗出示时，乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）处于领先位置，他在第二圈起步时超过了加斯利（Gasly）的阿尔派赛车。
加斯利位列第二，身后依次是维斯塔潘（Verdictappen）、阿尔派车队的第二位车手弗朗哥·科拉平托（科拉平托）、皮亚斯特里（Piastri）、他的迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）、阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad，小红牛车队）以及汉密尔顿（Hamilton）。
detailEn: Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix has been red-flagged following a huge crash for Charles Leclerc on the exit of the final corner at the end of the second lap.

The Ferraris ran side-by-side into the first turn on the opening lap with Hamilton diving down the inside of Leclerc - who, in Hamilton's view, proceeded to push him off the track and into the gravel at Turn 2.
Leclerc continued in third, then briefly overtook polesitter Pierre Gasly at the start of lap two before being repassed, and later dropped to fourth behind Max Verstappen's Red Bull.
And Leclerc's race then came to an end when he had a wobble through the Ascari chicane and lost control of his Ferrari at the Parabolica (Alboreto) and speared into the barriers at high speed.
Oscar Piastri's McLaren had been looking for a move into the corner and Leclerc appeared to run slightly wide onto the green Tarmac just off the track, with his Ferrari swapping ends on him.
Leclerc quickly emerged from his wrecked Ferrari and the safety car, then the red flag, were issued in quick succession.
The incident was similar to Leclerc's crash at Parabolica in the 2020 Italian GP.
Ferrari said shortly before the race was due to restart - at 3.39pm local time - that Leclerc had left the medical centre.
When the red flag was called George Russell led, having overtaken Gasly's Alpine at the start of lap two.
Gasly was second ahead of Verstappen, the second Alpine of Franco Colapinto, Piastri, his McLaren team-mate Lando Norris, Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) and Hamilton.

第二圈勒克莱尔曾短暂超越杆位起步的皮埃尔·加斯利后被反超，随后落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛掉到第四。
他在Ascari减速弯出现晃动后，在帕拉波利卡弯（Alboreto弯）失控，高速撞上护栏退赛。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton dived down the inside of Leclerc on lap one, who in Hamilton's view then pushed him off into the gravel at Turn 2.
Leclerc briefly overtook polesitter Pierre Gasly at the start of lap two before being repassed, then dropped to fourth behind Max Verstappen's Red Bull.

detailZh: 巨大撞车导致夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）退出F1意大利大奖赛
勒克莱尔在比赛第2圈发生高速事故后，退出了F1意大利大奖赛
法拉利F1车手夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛中撞车退赛，比赛在蒙扎进行两圈后出示红旗。
在第二圈结束时，勒克莱尔正在防守第四名，抵挡迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）的进攻，此时这位法拉利车手突然出现转向过度，他的法拉利赛车在高速的帕拉波利卡（Parabolica）右弯中甩出了车尾。
勒克莱尔（Leclerc）高速撞上外侧护栏后发生旋转，但他安然无恙地离开了赛车。不过安全车随后升级为全场红旗，以便赛事官员能够修复护栏。
对于法拉利车队来说，这对主场作战的他们是一个沉重的打击，而比赛开局就已经很糟糕——起步时勒克莱尔把队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）挤到了赛道外侧。汉密尔顿因此跌至第八位，梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）从意外夺得杆位的阿尔派车队车手皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利）手中接过了领先位置。
通过车队无线电，汉密尔顿愤怒地表示“夏尔把我挤出了赛道”，但这一事件不会受到赛事干事的调查。
鉴于撞击的严重程度，勒克莱尔前往医疗中心接受了预防性检查，但检查后确认无恙并已获准离开，没有受伤。
当地时间15:39，车手们进行了静止起步重启，车队被允许在暂停期间更换轮胎。
由于Russell将领先于Gasly、维斯塔潘和科拉平托进行重启，积分榜领跑者安东内利从第19位发车（因引擎处罚），一路追赶至第12位。
detailEn: Huge crash knocks Charles Leclerc out of F1 Italian GP
Leclerc was eliminated from Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix after a high-speed accident on lap 2
Ferrari Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc crashed out of the Italian Grand Prix, bringing out the red flag after two racing laps at Monza.

At the end of the second lap, Leclerc was defending fourth position from McLaren's Oscar Piastri when the Ferrari driver suffered a snap of oversteer and lost the rear of his Ferrari through the fast Parabolica right-hander.
Leclerc spun in the outside barriers at high speed, but walked away unhurt. But a safety car turned into a full red flag so race officials could repair the barriers.

It was a huge blow for Ferrari at its home race, which had already suffered a poor start when Leclerc pushed team-mate Lewis Hamilton wide at the start. Hamilton was demoted to eighth, with Mercedes' George Russell taking over the lead from surprise polesitter Pierre Gasly in the Alpine.
On the team radio, Hamilton fumed that "Charles pushed me off", an incident that will not be investigated by the stewards.
Given the severity of the impact, Leclerc headed to the medical centre for precautionary checks, but was cleared and released without injuries.
Drivers are took a standing restart at 15:39 local time, with teams allowed to make a tyre change during the stoppage.
As Russell will lead the restart from Gasly, Max Verstappen and Franco Colapinto, championship leader Kimi Antonelli worked his way up to 12th after starting down in 19th due to an engine penalty.

items.summaryEn: Colton Herta's Formula 2 season has been going from bad to worse, which nothing illustrates more clearly than his Monza weekend. The former IndyCar frontrunner was hired by the Cadillac Formula 1 team as a test and development driver for 2026 and switched to F2 ahead of a potential graduation to the world championship.
detailZh: 科尔顿·赫塔（Colton Herta）的2026赛季从糟糕变得更糟——两次冲出赛道，还在蒙扎遭遇一次赛车故障
在意大利的这个周末，赫塔可能经历了整个赛季最艰难的比赛，而他的F1梦想也随之脱轨
科尔顿·赫塔（Colton Herta）的F2赛季正从糟糕变得更糟，而他在蒙扎的这个周末最能说明这一点。
曾几何时是IndyCar领先车手的赫塔，被凯迪拉克F1车队聘为2026年的测试与发展车手，并转战F2，为可能晋级世界锦标赛做准备。
不过，虽然F2本来就注定充满挑战——他没有倍耐力轮胎的使用经验，也不熟悉这些赛道——但Herta目前在积分榜上仅排在第17位，成绩令人失望。
在10轮比赛中，这位Hitech车手只有一次排位赛进入前12名，而蒙扎更是他的新低谷：仅列第20位，落后领先者超过一秒。
但问题不仅仅在于速度。Herta在唯一一节F2练习赛中冲出赛道退赛，他在Lesmo 2弯出口处把两个车轮压进了砂石区，随后打旋转入内侧护栏。之后他参加了F1的一练，以满足凯迪拉克的新秀出场要求，但他的MAC-赛车在仅完成一个飞驰圈后就因疑似液压故障而抛锚。F2排位赛第20名的成绩更是让他这一天雪上加霜。
这是Herta第三次参加一练，他在凯迪拉克赛车里已经感觉“舒服得多”。“你知道的，就是对赛车需要什么、想要怎样被驾驶多了一点点了解，”他解释道。
“所有这些赛车都有一些微小的差异，正是这些差异让它们变得合拍。我在驾驶时努力去找到这种感觉，所以对赛车喜欢什么样的特性多一分了解就是很大的帮助，这让我感觉更自在。
“当你只有一个小时的时候，就好像，真的，当你坐在车里、一切都发生的时候，一切都进展得飞快。感觉你在车里只待了五分钟，所以你一下车就立刻会想，‘哦，我本该做这个’或者‘我本该做那个’。
“我想每个人都会说，如果在驾驶中任何事情上得到第二次机会，他们都会做得更好，对我来说肯定也是这样，那可能会是一个相当大的进步。
随后在周六的F2冲刺赛中，Herta仅获得第15名，而他的主赛在第11圈就结束了——他在Parabolica弯出口冲进了砂石区；当时他正排在第21位。
结果，他在积分榜上卡在了26分，过去10场比赛只拿到过一次前12名的完赛成绩。他与总冠军领跑者Nikola Tsolov之间相差151分，而剩下四轮总共只有156分可争，这意味着他在数学上几乎已经无缘总冠军。就连目前相差37分的前十名，现在看来也是一项艰巨的任务。
“我想做的是进入F1，而且我想尽快到达那里，”Herta说，“这有多现实，我还没有被告知，也不知道。”但2027年的F1席位几乎已经不再是一个选择了。
detailEn: Colton Herta’s 2026 season goes from bad to worse – two offs, one breakdown at Monza
Herta probably endured his toughest weekend of the campaign in Italy, as his F1 dream gets derailed
Colton Herta’s Formula 2 season has been going from bad to worse, which nothing illustrates more clearly than his Monza weekend.
Former IndyCar frontrunner Herta was hired by the Cadillac Formula 1 team as a test and development driver for 2026, and he switched to F2 ahead of a potential graduation to the world championship.
But while F2 was always going to be a challenge, given he had no experience of the Pirelli rubber and wasn’t familiar with the tracks, Herta lies an underwhelming 17th in the standings.
Over 10 rounds, the Hitech driver has qualified in the top 12 just once, and Monza was a new low for him with 20th place, more than a second off the pace.

It wasn’t just about pace, though. Herta crashed out of the only F2 practice session when he put two wheels in the gravel at the exit of Lesmo 2 and spun into the inside wall. He then partook in Formula 1 FP1 as Cadillac fulfilled its rookie requirements, but his MAC-26 broke down after just one push lap with a suspected hydraulic issue. That 20th position in F2 qualifying compounded his troubled day.

This was Herta’s third FP1 outing, and he had been feeling “a lot more” comfortable in the Cadillac. “You know, just kind of having that little bit of knowledge about what the car wants, or what the car needs, how it wants to be driven,” he explained.

“All these cars have tiny differences that make them click. I'm driving and trying to find that, so having a bit more knowledge of what the car likes to do is a big help, it makes me feel more comfortable.

“When you only have an hour, it seems like, literally when you're inside the car and everything's happening, everything's happening so quick. It seems like you're in there for five minutes, so you get out and you're instantly like, ‘Oh I should have done this’ or ‘I should have done that’.
“I think everybody would say if they get a second chance at anything when they're driving they would do better, and for sure for me it probably would have been a pretty big step.”
Herta then progressed to just 15th place in the F2 sprint race on Saturday, and his feature race ended on lap 11, in the gravel at the exit of Parabolica; he was running 21st.

As a consequence, he’s stuck on 26 points in the standings, having taken just one top 12 finish in the last 10 races. His 151-point deficit to championship leader Nikola Tsolov, with 156 available in the remaining four rounds, means he’s all but mathematically out of contention for the title. Even the top 10, now 37 points away, currently seems like a tall order.

“What I want to do is I want to get to Formula 1 and I want to get there as fast as possible,” Herta said. “How realistic that is, I have yet to be told or know.” But a 2027 F1 drive can hardly be an option anymore.
